newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy 76,000/T Feb-March fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy 76,000/T Feb-March fuel oil.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy two 38,000 tonne cargoes of 0.5 percent sulphur fuel oil for delivery between February and March, a company official said on Thursday.
CPC seeks a low pour point cargo for delivery between February 21 to March 15 to Keelung or Taichung and a high pour point cargo for delivery March 1 to 15 to Kaohsiung.
The tender closes February 3 and is valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC bought two 38,000 tonne cargo at betwen $136-$138 a tonne on a cost and freight basis.
